articles.title: A 16-Year-Old Guitar Hero From Thailand Just Won America's Got Talent!
articles.summary: Nene Royal, a 16-year-old from Thailand, shredded her electric guitar on America's Got Talent and won the whole show. Her first audition got 21 million views online. Now she's planning a rock album and a trip to Disneyland.

articles.title: Olivia Rodrigo's New Tour Started With a Dress That Dissolves and a Birthday Surprise
articles.summary: Olivia Rodrigo kicked off her Unraveled Tour in Hartford, Connecticut. The show had flowers everywhere, a dress that seemed to dissolve, and a sweet moment when she sang 'Happy Birthday' to her mom.

articles.title: Great Britain's Tennis Team Fought Hard but Lost to the Czech Republic
articles.summary: Great Britain lost to the Czech Republic in the Billie Jean King Cup quarter-finals. Sonay Kartal played a three-hour match after six months off with an injury. Captain Anne Keothavong said she couldn't fault her team's effort.
